verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships a first-party documented CLI with commands to develop and run tasks locally, self-host, and deploy to the cloud, and a probe confirms its official documentation. Community feedback praising Dev mode corroborates the local development workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI affordances (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive use by agents), and a detailed command reference beyond the introduction page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Trigger.dev CLI has a number of options and commands to help you develop locally, self host, and deploy your tasks.
Deploy your Trigger.dev project to the cloud.
